Game Overview

Monster Jumper is a animal game built around leap into action with Monster Jumper, where precision meets charm. Master simple tap controls to help an endearing creature soar from platform to platform. As you ascend, face increasingly tough challenges while avoiding obstacles and collecting points, making every jump a thrilling adventure!
